# apple_app_screenshot_set (Resource)

Sets an App Store version localization's screenshots for one display type, in order. App Store Connect needs screenshots for each device family the app supports; see "Screenshot specifications" for sizes. Apply uploads, replaces and reorders files to match `files`, and uploads a file again when its contents change. Changes need the version to be editable. Destroying the resource deletes the set while the version is editable, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<localization_id>/<display_type>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_screenshot_set" "iphone" {
  localization_id = apple_app_store_version_localization.en_us.id
  display_type    = "APP_IPHONE_67"
  files = [
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/1-home.png",
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/2-editor.png",
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/3-share.png",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_type` (String) Device the screenshots are for: `APP_IPHONE_67`, `APP_IPHONE_61`, `APP_IPHONE_65`, `APP_IPHONE_58`, `APP_IPHONE_55`, `APP_IPHONE_47`, `APP_IPHONE_40`, `APP_IPHONE_35`, `APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129`, `APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_11`, `APP_IPAD_PRO_129`, `APP_IPAD_105`, `APP_IPAD_97`, `APP_DESKTOP`, `APP_WATCH_ULTRA`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_10`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_7`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_4`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_3`, `APP_APPLE_TV`, `APP_APPLE_VISION_PRO`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_67`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_61`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_65`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_58`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_55`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_47`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPHONE_40`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_11`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPAD_PRO_129`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPAD_105`, `IMESSAGE_APP_IPAD_97`.
- `files` (List of String) Paths of the screenshot files, in display order; up to 10. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version localization, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_localization.en_us.id`.

### Read-Only

- `checksums` (List of String) MD5 checksums of the files, in order.
- `file_ids` (List of String) App Store Connect IDs of the uploaded files, in order.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_screenshot_set.iphone
  identity = {
    localization_id = "1234567890"
    display_type    = "APP_IPHONE_67"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `display_type` (String) Display type of the set.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_screenshot_set.iphone 1234567890/APP_IPHONE_67
```
